newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: CRICKET-SRI LANKA PICKS TEENAGER FOR NZ TOUR.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SRI LANKA PICKS TEENAGER FOR NZ TOUR.

text.p: Sri Lanka has included an 18-year-old bowler in a squad of five fast bowlers for its tour of New Zealand from February 26 to March 27, cricket board officials said on Friday.
Left-arm fast medium-pacer Nuwan Soysa will make his debut with the Sri Lankan national team, winners of the 1996 World Cup championship.
Soysa will be one of five fast bowlers picked for the tour, which will consist of two test matches and three one-day internationals, the Board of Control for Cricket in Sri Lanka said.
The other seamers are Chaminda Vaas, Promodya Wickremasinghe, Sanjeewa de Silva and Ravindra Pushpakumara. All-rounders Ruwan Kalpage and Upul Chandana were dropped from the 15-man squad.

Squad: Arjuna Ranatunga (captain), Aravinda de Silva, Sanath Jayasuriya, Romesh Kaluwitharana, Roshan Mahanama, Asanka Gurusinha, Hashan Tillekeratne, Chaminda Vaas, Muttiah Muralitharan, Ravindra Pushpakumara, Kumara Dharmasena, Sanjeewa de Silva, Promodya Wickremasinghe, Marvan Atapattu and Nuwan Soysa.
